root_causes.description: The checkout container was killed by a deployment spec change ('Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted') and its replacement pod cannot start because the sandbox image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest fails to pull (DeadlineExceeded → ImagePullBackOff), leaving checkout NotReady and unable to serve traffic. This is the direct cause of the checkout request-rate collapse.

evidence.query_or_id: Killing: Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted

evidence.observed_value: count=4; preceded by 'Failed to pull image "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest": rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded' and ErrImagePull
evidence.expected_baseline: 0 image pull failures; pause image present on node

evidence.query_or_id: Failed: Failed to pull image "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest": rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = failed to pull a
evidence.observed_value: count=2 (plus count=1 variant) image pull DeadlineExceeded
evidence.expected_baseline: pause image pull succeeds on pod sandbox creation

evidence.observed_value: error_rate=0.000 (checkout server span producing no responses)
evidence.expected_baseline: error_rate < 0.01; a serving pod would emit non-zero request/response spans

root_causes.description: checkout memory working set showed an anomalous excursion during the window (max 25.3 MB vs baseline p50 0.5 MB), consistent with a container being torn down/restarted rather than a sustained memory-pressure fault.

evidence.observed_value: mean=5,323,708 bytes, p50=548,864, max=25,333,760; anomaly flagged in window
evidence.expected_baseline: steady ~0.5 MB working set for a healthy checkout container

root_causes.description: frontend calls checkout directly, so if checkout is unavailable the frontend would surface downstream failures; however this is propagation from the checkout outage, not an independent fault, as checkout serves zero traffic.

evidence.observed_value: frontend → checkout dependency edge present in service topology

remediation_steps: Roll back the checkout Deployment to the previous working container definition — the event 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' shows a recent spec change triggered the kill.

Fix the sandbox image pull failure: the pull of gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest fails with DeadlineExceeded — verify registry connectivity/DNS, use an accessible mirror or pre-seed the pause image on the node, or set imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent.
Confirm the replacement checkout pod reaches Ready (no ImagePullBackOff) and verify checkout server request_rate returns to baseline.
Add a preflight/sync step to ensure the pause sandbox image is cached on nodes to avoid future ImagePullBackOff on pod recreation.
